thread.title: Dragon Ball Super: Broly Movie Collaboration Event Comes To Dragon Ball Z: Dokkan Battle

title: Dragon Ball Super: Broly Movie Collaboration Event Comes To Dragon Ball Z: Dokkan Battle
text:
Dragon Ball Super: Broly Movie Collaboration Event Comes To Dragon Ball Z: Dokkan Battle Posted: 1 hour, 59 mins ago | Apps Press Releases | Stock Ticker: NASDAQ:AAPL, NASDAQ:GOOG Comment | Email to a Friend | Font Size: A A
BANDAI NAMCO Entertainment Inc. today announced that DRAGON BALL Z: DOKKAN BATTLE , the renowned mobile RPG that brings together fan-favorite characters from across the iconic DRAGON BALL universe, has officially launched a collaboration campaign to celebrate the worldwide release of the new film, DRAGON BALL SUPER: BROLY.
During the event, players will be able to experience the events of DRAGON BALL SUPER: BROLY in a two-part story mode via DRAGON BALL Z: DOKKAN BATTLE's distinctive hybrid of match-3 battles and board game-style gameplay. The first half of the story is available now, with the second half launching on February 14th.
The collaboration campaign will also feature a Dual Dokkan Festival, with two highly-anticipated characters added to the summoning pool: Broly Super Saiyan Full Power , the film's titular character and antagonist, as well as Super Saiyan God Super Saiyan Gogeta , the fused form of Goku and Vegeta. Additionally, past Battle Z Supreme events will be made available to players again for a limited time.
DRAGON BALL Z: DOKKAN BATTLE is currently available as a free download on the Apple App Store for iPhones and iPads and Google Play for Android devices. Additional information on the movie collaboration event can be found on the game's official Facebook Page: https://www.Facebook.com/dokkanbattle.dbz/
